1182-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Stonecoil Serpent is in your graveyard.
1182-5006-8170.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Stonecoil Serpent. It enters as dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat.

813-2320-3306.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Slip On the Ring.
813-2320-3306.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and causing the Ring to tempt you, and putting Slip On the Ring into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Slip On the Ring to your hand.
Repeat.

883-3220-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-3220-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1170-3075-8210.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1170-3075-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

5078-6766-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4067-6810-7902.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
4067-6810-7902.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters, Fateful Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-1309-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-1309-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Salvager of Secrets without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Salvager of Secrets) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-1309-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

101-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Vampire Charmseeker.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from exile to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2232-7827-7831-7833.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7831-7833.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2438-2626-3652-4986.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Quicksilver Gargantuan each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-1376-7730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-7730.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4771-5660-7729.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

539-3899-4552-7290-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1690-2364-2538-4668.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Heliod
1690-2364-2538-4668.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2364-2538-4668.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1020-2510-2866-5231.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1020-2510-2866-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

4222-5268-6936.description:
Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

2060-2146-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2292-3234-3293-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2292-3234-3293-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
2292-3234-3293-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-1430-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Mirror Image.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Mirror Image by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2366-5003-6662.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

500-2523-4094-4365.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
500-2523-4094-4365.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control plus one.
Repeat step 5 for the remaining triggers.
500-2523-4094-4365.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

962-1912-4449-4613.notablePrerequisites:

Yurlok of Scorch Thrash has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
962-1912-4449-4613.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash using Hateflayer's ability by paying {R} and untapping it, causing Yurlok of Scorch Thrash to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

336-343-1369-4300-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one basic Forest card in hand.
You are the monarch.
336-343-1369-4300-5299.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Gaea's Touch until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Gaea's Touch ability by paying {0}, putting a basic Forest from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth's second ability triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

385-2106-2459-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mortarpod attached to Rograkh.
Fighter Class is at least level two.
385-2106-2459-4763.description:
Activate Rograkh by sacrificing it.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rograkh ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Mortarpod's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Rograkh.
Repeat.

1030-2034-2534.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-2534.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

573-1479-2907.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-2907.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
